hooks.name: AI Code Review (Manual, Diff-Only)
hooks.description: Runs one AI review pass over the story's changed files. Triggered manually after implementation is complete and build/lint/tests pass locally. Replaces the previous on-save hook, which started an agent run on every file save.

action.prompt:
Review only the changes introduced by this story. Use git diff against the base branch as the source of truth. Do not review unchanged files or unrelated folders.

Perform ONE review pass. Report actual issues only: functional bugs, incorrect API usage, security issues, broken logic, missing validation, obvious regressions.

Apply the fixes directly. Do not refactor unrelated files. Do not rewrite existing correct code. Do not run another review pass unless a fix introduces a new build or test failure; if it does, check only that failure.

Save findings to docs/code-review/{ISSUE-KEY}-ai-review.md.
